remarks: Sandwich Road Colonial with In-Law Apartment - A Rare Find!  Welcome to Sandwich Road, one of Greenwich's most sought-after locations-where timeless charm meets modern convenience. This two-story Colonial offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, perfectly designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining.  Features: A private 1-bedroom in-law/au pair suite with its own entrance, cozy fireplace, and full bath-ideal for extended family or guests.  Inside the main home, you'll find:  A sun-drenched living room with a wood-burning fireplace  A functional flow from the kitchen to the dining and living areas  A spacious two-car garage  A level, 1+ acre yard-perfect for outdoor gatherings  Located on quiet, tree-lined Sandwich Road, you're just minutes to schools, parks, shopping, dining, and Metro-North for an easy NYC commute.  This is the kind of opportunity that doesn't come often-and won't last long.
